name: 은설

frames.naturalBodyMethod: Standing idle neck-to-hip reference: 149px torso / 514.4px natural body. Individual lunge torso is 314px; use 1085px natural reference to prevent longer independently drawn lunge legs from shrinking the head/torso. Applied uniformly to the entire native actor.
frames.notes: Genuine newly drawn right-facing two-hand forward contact. Shared by slash/ultimate contact phase. Two distinct hands are on one straight handle/guard/blade axis; no body-part composite.

frames.naturalBodyMethod: Standing idle neck-to-hip reference: 149px torso / 514.4px natural body. Individual follow-through torso is 311px; use 1075px natural reference consistently with the contact pose. Applied uniformly to whole actor independently of sword bounds.
frames.notes: Genuine newly drawn two-handed down-right follow-through. Shared by slash/ultimate follow-through phase; the whole sword is straight and hands grip the same handle.
